title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts Level Schedule: Service Scope, Screening and Documents
content:
Each level of a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts contractor account carries its own service scope, screening cycle and document terms. The figures below apply to the level the account holds.

## Schedule

| Level | Service scope | Insured vehicle and valid licence on file | Minimum age to hold the account | Minimum age for batches containing alcohol | Background check re-run every | Document grace period after a licence or insurance expiry date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | Shop only: the shopper shops and stages, and does not deliver | Not required | 18 years | 21 years | 24 calendar months | 0 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper | Full service: the shopper shops and also delivers | Required | 18 years | 21 years | 12 calendar months | 7 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | Full service | Required | 18 years | 21 years | 12 calendar months | 7 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | Full service | Required | 18 years | 21 years | 12 calendar months | 7 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | Full service | Required | 18 years | 21 years | 12 calendar months | 14 calendar days |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | Full service | Required | 18 years | 21 years | 12 calendar months | 14 calendar days |

## Entry to the two entry levels

| Level | What the account must show to be held at this level |
|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | Shop-only service scope, no vehicle requirement, and a background check that has come back clear |
| Full-Service Shopper | Full-service scope, an insured vehicle and valid licence on file, a background check that has come back clear, and a motor vehicle record that has come back clear |

## Notes on the columns

- **Document grace period.** The number of calendar days after the expiry date of the licence or vehicle insurance on file during which the account stays active while the renewed document is awaited. At Shop-Only Shopper the figure is 0, and no vehicle document is required at that level.
- **Background check re-run.** The interval, in calendar months, at which the background check on the account is run again: every 24 months at Shop-Only Shopper and every 12 months at each Full-Service level.
- **Alcohol age.** The minimum age of 21 governs batches that contain alcohol; the minimum age of 18 governs holding the account at all.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical examples)

- A hypothetical Full-Service Shopper Platinum account whose vehicle insurance expired on a given day stays inside its document grace period for the 14 calendar days after that date; the same expiry on a Full-Service Shopper Gold account has a grace period of 7 calendar days.
- A hypothetical 19-year-old at any level may hold the account, since 19 is at least 18, but is below the alcohol-batch age of 21.
